name: Black Diary: Remake
source:
The girl wakes up on the cold, hard ground. She feels blood slowly dripping down her head. She doesn't know how she got here, but she's convinced it's some kind of college prank. Is she on the right track, or could something more sinister be at play?

[From [url=https://lehxra.itch.io/black-diary-remake-chapter-one]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
女孩在冰冷坚硬的地面上醒来。她感觉血慢慢地顺着她的头流下来。她不知道自己是怎么来到这里的，但她确信这是某种大学恶作剧。她是否走在正确的道路上，还是可能有更险恶的事情在起作用？

[来自[url=https://lehxra.itch.io/black-diary-remake-chapter-one]Itch.io[/url]]
